articles.title: Seattle Teachers Vote Overwhelmingly to Authorize Strike, First Day of School at Risk
articles.description: Seattle Education Association members approved a strike authorization, indicating willingness to walk out if contract negotiations fail by Sept. 1. The move puts the start of the school year for 50,000 students in jeopardy, as the union and district continue bargaining over unresolved terms.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Completes 5 Years, Offers 53 Employment-Oriented Courses
articles.description: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Gorakhpur has completed five years of operation, expanding from 12 courses in 2021 to 53 specialised and employment-oriented programmes. The university offers MBBS, BAMS, nursing, agriculture, pharmacy and management courses, while strengthening research through collaborations with several national and international institutions.
